subject: 明代北方两层商铺，7×5格，灰砖硬山布货铺（原创扩展；细部待考）
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: tianshu default building-map, ONE isolated reusable game building cutout, true RGBA transparent background. Image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its realistic historical painted material quality, crisp detailed grey roof tiles, believable aged masonry and wood, natural muted colors and detail density. Do not copy its building or old camera inaccuracies. This is a new Ming-era northern Chinese prefectural-town building, original game design, NOT restoration of a named monument. Camera MUST be orthographic dimetric 2:1 ground projection, yaw 45 degrees elevation 30 degrees: ground edges exact +0.5 and -0.5 slopes, all verticals upright, no vanishing point. Main frontage faces screen lower left. Ground footprint must be a thin flat rectangular apron with clearly visible straight left-to-front and front-to-right edges, front base corner visible, no thick pedestal or surrounding street. Entire eaves, ground edge and short shadow fully inside square frame with 10 percent transparent margins. Sunlight screen upper left, short soft contact shadow screen lower right. Northern Ming hard-gable YINGSHAN roof: restrained straight ridge, grey clay concave and convex roof tiles, low subtle ridge terminals, solid masonry gable ends flush with verge eaves, not overhanging timber gables, EXPOSED GREY BRICK ALL walls, NO white or cream plaster, subdued dark timber lattice doors/windows; no Qing imperial decoration. No written characters, signboards, lettering, symbols, people, background scenery, sky, horizon, mountains, labels, watermark, checkerboard, opaque floor, exaggerated curved eaves, cartoon or toy-like stylization. Generate exactly ONE asset. Subject: ONE two-storey northern Ming commercial shop, footprint7m by5m. A compact grey-brick merchant shop with a plain timber storefront and unlabelled cloth bolts at ground floor, upstairs dark timber lattice windows beneath plain hard-gable grey tile roof. Small narrow wooden balcony facing screen lower left, no external stair. Tall grey-brick sidewall, modest unpainted wood columns. No signs or words. Distinctly two levels but no pagoda tiers or ornate eaves. On thin rectangular ground perimeter with left-to-front width7 and front-to-right depth5, visible horizontal edge span ratio7:5. Ground edge slopes+.5 and-.5. ALL walls grey masonry, NO white plaster. Preserve whole building on transparent canvas with generous empty border. Isolated single commercial building only. Revision for precise ground dimetric camera: target reference must NOT dictate roof silhouette: proper NORTH CHINESE YINGSHAN hard-gabled roofs, flush grey-brick triangular gable walls rising to ridge at both ends, NO overhanging eaves at gable ends, no upward-curled corner tips. Ground outline MUST be SHALLOWER in projection: horizontal floor edges at26.565 degrees from horizontal, NOT30 degrees, slope0.5. Thin floor apron parallelogram wide7 deep5, long edge horizontal span560px and rise280px, short edge horizontal span400px and rise200px. These are placement proportions only, NO text or grid drawn.
